scenarios.name: member_found
scenarios.description: The happy path: an existing member, balance read.

scenarios.name: member_not_found
scenarios.description: The bank answering a question. Must be returned cleanly, not raised.

scenarios.name: permission_denied
scenarios.description: A second business outcome through the same generic detection.

scenarios.name: our_typing_did_not_land
scenarios.description: The app reports an empty Member ID. Same alert mechanism as a business outcome, opposite classification: this one is our bug.

scenarios.name: drift_absorbed_by_rung_two
scenarios.description: The accessible label is renamed. The run must still succeed AND must do so via the relational rung — asserting only the bucket would pass even if rung 1 had quietly started working again.

scenarios.name: drift_too_large_to_absorb
scenarios.description: A control is removed outright. No rung can find what is not there, and pretending otherwise would be worse than failing.

scenarios.name: interstitial_recovered
scenarios.description: A known interstitial is dismissed in-loop and the run continues, so Recoverable never reaches the caller.

scenarios.name: slow_response_waited_for
scenarios.description: A 2s delay. Passing here means the checkpoint was waited on rather than slept through.

scenarios.name: unknown_blocker_stops_the_run
scenarios.description: A screen no recording ever saw. With no operator configured this must stop rather than guess.

scenarios.name: branch_code_did_not_land
scenarios.description: The mirror of our_typing_did_not_land, for the anonymous field. Added because the eval harness reported branch_code_not_submitted as declared but never reached — the outcome existed only on paper.

scenarios.name: session_expired_mid_flow
scenarios.description: The app signs us out mid-flow. Named in known_outcomes, so it is detected in milliseconds rather than by waiting out the checkpoint timeout — and classified hard_failure because re-authenticating needs credentials the automation must never handle.
